# Kaftan Angelo - Budapest Leather Store

## About Us
Kaftan Angelo is a premium leather and fur clothing store located in the heart of Budapest, Hungary. We offer high-quality genuine leather jackets for men and women, shearling coats, fur styles, and leather accessories.

## Location & Contact
- **Address:** Kossuth Lajos u. 18, Budapest, 1053, Hungary (between Astoria and Ferenciek tere, District V / Belváros).
- **Phone:** +36 1 266 7274
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/keuQRmecRpFn5Vjr5
- **Instagram:** [@kaftanangelo.budapest](https://www.instagram.com/kaftanangelo.budapest/)

## Opening Hours
- **Monday to Friday:** 10:00 - 19:00
- **Saturday:** 10:00 - 17:00
- **Sunday:** Closed

## Products & Services
- **Women's Leather Jackets:** Classic and modern genuine leather styles.
- **Men's Leather Jackets:** Genuine leather jackets in various fits and sizes (including biker and classic styles).
- **Shearling Coats:** Warm shearling jackets and coats for men and women.
- **Fur Jackets & Coats:** Women's fur jackets, coats, and fox fur vests.
- **Leather Accessories:** Genuine leather belts, wallets, hats, and scarves.
- **Custom Orders:** Custom-made leather jackets tailored to specific styles, colors, and sizes.
- **Repairs:** Repair assistance for leather items purchased in-store.

## Languages Spoken
- Hungarian (Magyar)
- English
- German (Deutsch)
- Turkish (Türkçe)
- Arabic (العربية)

## Why Choose Us?
- Located conveniently in central Budapest.
- Try on all items in-store.
- Decades of experience in leather craftsmanship (established in Istanbul in 1973, in Budapest since 2004).
- Customization and tailoring services available.
